description: This file defines macros, data structures, and constants for configuring the ARMv8-R64 Memory Protection Unit (MPU) on ARM Cortex-R architecture within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes register definitions, attribute flags, region configuration macros, and structures for MPU region and configuration management.

classes.name: arm_mpu_region
classes.description: Structure representing an MPU region with base, limit, name, and attributes.

classes.name: arm_mpu_region_attr
classes.description: Structure defining attributes for an MPU region, including access permissions and cache settings.

classes.name: arm_mpu_config
classes.description: Structure holding the MPU configuration, including number of regions and region array.

methods.name: MPU_REGION_ENTRY
methods.description: Macro to initialize an MPU region entry with name, base, limit, and attributes.
